title: Human-readable duration
hints: Handle the two special cases first: `0` returns `"0s"`, and a negative input means "write `-`, then work with `-seconds`".
Integer division and `%` split the value into parts: `days := s / 86400`, `hours := s % 86400 / 3600`, `minutes := s % 3600 / 60`, `secs := s % 60`. Build the result with a `strings.Builder`.

Write a small closure `add := func(n int, unit string)` that does nothing when `n == 0`, otherwise writes a space (only if a part was already written) followed by `strconv.Itoa(n) + unit`. Call it four times, largest unit first.
